name: testboard-pasker-id
description: TestBoard PASKER ID - multi-project UAT, test execution, evidence and bug tracking web app

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @testboard/api" "npm run dev -w @testboard/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @testboard/shared && npm run build -w @testboard/api && npm run build -w @testboard/web
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
